note: Bluegrass festival venue (Labor Day weekend festival) that sells RV camping year-round; dry-camping fields, shaded areas and sites around a fishing pond (no swimming). A portable RV waste tank is lent if needed. --Claude
summary: Operator's 2026 page confirms year-round general RV camping sold by the night ($35 daily; Hipcamp lists $45 W/E, $25 dry), phone/email reservations, 35 power+water sites (15x30A, 16x50A), bathhouse with hot showers, dump, WiFi; festivals are Labor Day weekend. Passes long-stay test 2 (posted nightly rate + phone). Gate n/a.
